name: NFPrompt
classificationNote: Upstream label missing; classified by keyword rules from the root-cause text.
rootCause: NFPrompt announced on its social media platform that the team detected issues with Web2 wallet service. They assured users about the security of their funds and recommended using self-custodied Web3 wallets. For users facing issues, they were advised to open a ticket in the project's Discord channel to mitigate the problem.

descriptions.text: NFPrompt announced on its social media platform that the team detected issues with Web2 wallet service. They assured users about the security of their funds and recommended using self-custodied Web3 wallets. For users facing issues, they were advised to open a ticket in the project's Discord channel to mitigate the problem.
Fake NFPrompt (NFP) on BSC is suspected of a rug pull, with the deployer removing substantial liquidity, causing a 100% price decline.
